Staying at Vietview Hotel gives all the guests chances to access to business centers and attractions easily and conveniently. Within 5 minutes walking, the guests can visit Hoan Kiem Lake (Sword Lake), Water Puppet Theater and other landmarks include Old Quarter of Ha Noi, Dong Xuan Market, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Temple of Literature Vietview Hotel offers 52 exquisite guest rooms, suites and family suite, which take inspiration from the graceful Vietnamese design with bright wooden floor . Emphasizing the welcoming and comfortable atmosphere, our rooms feature tasteful furnishing with modern technology and unique ambience. Vietview Hotel's Restaurant and Bar surely provide unique dinning experiences. Other services of Vietview Hotel are available all day long including complimentary international breakfast daily or even room services. Modern and well - appointed guest rooms with wooden floor, unique wooden bathtub and separate walk in rain shower, offer city view except some rooms on low floors have view to the shaft.
